query.text: 请帮我照看狗狗，每次出现需要关注的表现时告诉我。
query.text_en: Please watch over the dog and tell me each time it shows behavior needing attention.

annotation.text_zh: 狗狗在食碗旁发出哼唧声。您看看狗狗怎么了。
annotation.text_en: The dog is whining beside the food bowl. Please check on the dog.

annotation.text_zh: 狗狗开始大声嚎叫。您看看狗狗怎么了。
annotation.text_en: The dog has started howling loudly. Please check on the dog.

annotation.text_zh: 狗狗又开始嚎叫了。您看看狗狗怎么了。
annotation.text_en: The dog has started howling again. Please check on the dog.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
